EXPLANATORY NOTES: This chart represents MAID data where the report was received by Health Canada by January 31, 2023. For 2021, this represents 13,102 MAID deaths and an overall total of 16,104 written requests. MAID cases are counted in the calendar year in which the death occurred (i.e., January 1 to December 31), and are not related to the date of receipt of the written request. Due to small numbers, some data have been suppressed to protect confidentiality (represented by dashes). Statistics Canada.
